spec.name: Furniture Bone Reliquary
spec.description: A compact ivory-framed reliquary with sculpted ribs, a dark oak lid and a violet seal, resting on an integrated squat stone pedestal. Front faces negative Z. Seventeen connected, axis-aligned cuboids with distinct cube-net UVs.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: small mysterious ivory bone reliquary chest with ribbed bone frame, dark lid and violet inset gem on a squat stone pedestal; stylized clean bones. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
